summary: Create a decision environment under Automation Decisions > Decision Environments: name, organization, full image path with registry and tag, optional credential, and Pull policy: Always (check registry every run), Only if not present (use local cache, good for stable production), or Never (local image only; activation fails if missing).
questions: How do I create a decision environment in Event-Driven Ansible?
What are the decision environment pull options?
Why did my activation fail with 'Never pull container before running'?
Which pull policy should I use in production?

answer_card.title: Decision environment pull policies
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Always pull container before running**: checks the registry before every use; best for security patches and staging.
- **Only pull the image if not present**: uses the local cache when the image exists; good for stable production and faster starts.
- **Never pull container before running**: uses only a locally present image; the activation **fails** if it isn't there, so pull it manually first.
